path_base: Utilities workspace root (the parent of ANIMA)
semantics: This catalogue records logical identities, current source paths, responsibilities, and status. A source path is mutable and is not a release, version pin, runtime deployment, or proof of integration. Source location, runtime placement, state custody, ownership, access, and execution placement are separate.

historical_candidate_pin.sha256_scope: candidate-shasums.txt hashes committer.py and approval.py individually; these are not Git commit hashes or whole-tree/package hashes
historical_candidate_pin.status: historical_selected_candidate_revision_and_file_hashes; not a new ANIMA consumer pin

tl_sys_adapter.status: selected family member; current adapter tree remains mutable
tl_sys_adapter.post_release_repair: ATOM_SCHEME=tlsys-v1-occurrence with identity.py, ingest.py, and index.py changes recorded in ORGANIZATION-CONFORMANCE.md

entries.qualification: Keep the historical per-document release scope distinct from broader S-01/S-02/S-03/S-04 obligations and any expanded release.

TRACE’s actual evidence, history, inference, activation, and remaining conformance conditions stay scoped to its owning records. An initial release may explicitly defer SST integration; that does not erase later obligations.
Early experience-learning insertion points are not evidence of a qualified adaptive learner. STC’s package named substrate is mechanical and distinct from hosting.substrate.
Search reuse does not transfer domain evaluation or custody authority. Mock-only integration evidence does not establish a real caller.

historical_integration_evidence.evidence_scope: historical P03 pinned/read-only controller compatibility; not a current HEAD pin or live-model qualification

entries.qualification: Future work must demonstrate a real state, responsibility, ownership, lifecycle, or internal-machinery change and subsequent reuse. Folder organization and messaging are not that evidence.
Distinguish prediction discrepancies, explicit requirement/preference corrections, check failures, comparative workflow advantages, and evaluator defects.

not_selected: No new ANIMA module release versions, consumer pins, dependency locks, or runtime deployments are selected by this catalogue. Historical candidate identities cited above are evidence references, not current ANIMA pins.
No physical source repository is moved or copied into ANIMA.
